title: Jokes Teller Program
prompt:
Create a program that tells jokes with user-inputted names and locations.
Sample Input: name, location
Sample Output: Why did {name} go to {location}? Because they heard the food was great!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you create a program that tells jokes based on user-inputted names and locations. Here's a Python solution using the `random` module to select jokes from a list. You can add or remove jokes from the list as needed.

```python
import random

jokes = [
    "Why did {name} go to {location}? Because they heard the food was great!",
    "What do you call a {name} from {location}? An exotic dancer!",
    "Why did {name} visit {location}? To see the famous {location} landmarks!",
    "How did {name} spend their weekend in {location}? Watching the sunset and enjoying the local cuisine!",
    "Why did {name} go to {location}? To escape the cold and enjoy the warm weather!",
]

def tell_joke(name, location):
    joke = jokes[random.randint(0, len(jokes) - 1)]
    joke = joke.format(name=name, location=location)
    return joke

if __name__ == "__main__":
    name = input("Enter your name: ")
    location = input("Enter a location: ")

    joke = tell_joke(name, location)
    print(f"\n{joke}")
```

This program prompts the user to enter their name and a location, then generates a random joke based on those inputs. You can customize the jokes list to include more or different jokes.
